name: Remote Receiver → On Rc5X
description: An automation to perform when a RC5X (Marantz Extended RC5) remote code has been decoded. A variable `x` of type <APIStruct text="remote_base::RC5XData" path="remote_base::RC5XData" /> is passed to the automation for use in lambdas. It has the fields `address`, `command` and `extension`.
